title: Exhaustive and feasible parametrisation with applications to the travelling salesperson problem
summary: This paper introduces the concept of exhaustively parametrised, feasibility-respecting quantum circuits for constrained combinatorial optimisation problems. Such circuits can reach, given the right parameter values, every feasible solution with certainty -- including the optimum -- with a fixed number of parameters, while avoiding infeasible solutions altogether. This is in sharp contrast to conventional quantum alternating operator ansatz schemes, which are merely guaranteed to reach the optimum asymptotically.
